title: UE-requested PDU session release procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to release a PDU session, which can be accepted by the network.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request release of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Identifier that specifies which PDU session is to be released.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to release a PDU session, as specified in subclause 6.3.3.

entities.name: SMF accepts release request
entities.description: Condition where SMF accepts the UE's request to release the PDU session.

relations.description: UE-requested PDU session release procedure involves sending PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message.
PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message contains PDU session ID.
When SMF accepts the release request, it triggers the network-requested PDU session release procedure.
UE-requested procedure outcome depends on SMF acceptance condition.
